name: A Song for A Swig
source:
You play as Roedahn, a barkeep running a bustling tavern in town.
Like every other day, the tavern is filled with patrons but one fine afternoon, a bird shows up. You've met your fair share of weirdlings from far and wide but this...was different.

Their name is Berdios.

Berd wants a drink.
Berd has 0 coins.
Berd will do whatever it takes to convince you.

Will you be charmed by this little magpie and serve them a glass on the house?

[From [url=https://azufx.itch.io/a-song-for-a-swig]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Roedahn，一个在镇上经营一家熙熙攘攘的小酒馆的酒吧老板。
和往常一样，小酒馆里挤满了顾客，但在一个晴朗的下午，一只鸟出现了。你见过很多来自四面八方的怪人，但这……不同。

他们的名字叫贝尔迪奥斯。

伯德想喝一杯。
伯德 有0个硬币。
伯德会尽一切努力来说服你。

你会被这只小喜鹊迷住并在家里为它们奉上一杯酒吗？

[来自[url=https://azufx.itch.io/a-song-for-a-swig]itch.io[/url]]
